protocol: All 432 result words and 580 candidate relations reviewed in this conversation, considering alternative parents together.
Use actual dictionary senses of both parents; distinguish lexical coincidences, homonyms, international components and direct/indirect motivation.
accept means semantically compatible; it does not prove historical or unique immediate derivation.
uncertain cases are preserved separately; reject decisions concern relations, not existence of words.
No external model API or independent second reviewer was used.
